crossRefs.note: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

translations.web: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
translations.bsb: Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”
translations.kjv: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
translations.asv: He that is of God heareth the words of God: for this cause ye hear them not, because ye are not of God.
